publication_format.reference: $case_material_ref paths are relative to this case directory. Resolve the JSON Pointer, recursively expand, and verify SHA-256 of UTF-8 canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False).
publication_format.delta: case_itinerary_delta_1 replaces only specified top-level keys on the fully expanded base; verify the expanded semantic hash.
publication_format.source_identifiers: Original logical paths identify private archive entries; they are not public navigation links. Raw native inventories and receipts retain their exact original bytes.
publication_format.projections: Selected fields and sanitized projections are explicitly marked; they are reader views, not native closed replay bundles.
publication_format.line_endings: Canonical input uses the exact accepted native r02 bytes; published selected JSON values are unchanged.

entries.transformation: Original generation/primary cohorts unchanged; current paired oracle phase and applicable known subtotal refreshed.

human_acceptance.source: Explicit human decision in the case-07 conversation; includes all report limitations.

publication_correction.scope: Offline public-material presentation and saved-evidence extraction; original step-10 approval, selected outputs, failures and scores are unchanged.
publication_correction.historical_index_resolution: Frozen indexes and their original reader paths resolve at their recorded Git revision; relocated_public_paths locates current public equivalents.
publication_correction.evidence_storage: Private archives and original worktrees are retained without writes; native source paths are immutable evidence identifiers, not public navigation.

density_policy_derivations.scope: New offline density reports; original factual sources, receipts and prior acceptance remain unchanged.
